EN.question: Is it allowed to drive at full speed at night in a zone marked by A27?

choices.text: No, the risk of wildlife collisions is greatest at night; you must adjust your speed so you can stop for any visible obstacle
Yes, the speed limit applies at night too unless another sign indicates otherwise

EN.explanation: Large wild animals are most active at dusk and at night. You are always required to adjust your speed to conditions. At night in a wildlife zone your stopping distance must not exceed your visibility distance.
